response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and accomplished software engineer, but his background is heavily focused on full-stack web development, Node.js, TypeScript, and DLang. He lacks the mandatory 5 to 10 years of hands-on C++ development experience on Windows, possessing only a brief 7-month stint with C/C++ in 2014-2015. Furthermore, he does not have the required specialized domain expertise in Capital Markets, Fixed Income, or Investment Banking, making him a poor fit for this specific role.
strengths: Over 15 years of extensive software engineering experience across diverse tech stacks.
Strong proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and test-driven development (TDD).
Familiarity with high-throughput systems and microservices architectures.
concerns: Severely lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience.
No demonstrated experience with Windows platform development or enterprise SQL Server/Oracle databases.
Missing required domain expertise in Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking.
